expectations.text: app.config.ts adds provideSkewRecovery({ identity: BUILD_IDENTITY, manifestUrl: ... }) importing identity from the skew-stamp-generated module
expectations.evidence: app.config.ts:16-52 — provideSkewRecovery({ identity: BUILD_IDENTITY, manifestUrl: '/skew-manifest.json', ... }) with BUILD_IDENTITY imported from './generated/build-id'.

expectations.text: Lazy routes are wrapped as lazy('<module-id>', () => import(...)) so the id cross-references the manifest
expectations.evidence: app.routes.ts:23,27 — lazy('admin.routes', () => import('./admin/admin.routes')) and lazy('editor.routes', ...), with comments explaining the manifest cross-reference and id stability.

expectations.text: Build wiring runs skew-stamp before the app build to generate build-id.ts and again (or with flags) to emit skew-manifest.json, with --assets pointing at the browser output dir
expectations.evidence: package.json — predev/prebuild run `skew-stamp --out src/generated/build-id.ts`; postbuild adds `--manifest dist/bulletin-app/browser/skew-manifest.json --assets dist/bulletin-app/browser`. Matches the real CLI flags exactly.

expectations.text: Manifest is documented/configured to be served with no-store (or explicitly uncached) semantics
expectations.evidence: manifest-cache-headers.snippet.txt provides Firebase Hosting and nginx configs: no-store for skew-manifest.json, no-cache for index.html, immutable for hashed chunks — and explains why a cached manifest breaks the probe.

expectations.text: Stale-origin loop prevention is delegated to the library's classification (not a hand-rolled reload counter) and the answer does not add an unconditional location.reload() fallback
expectations.evidence: No location.reload() anywhere; app.config.ts comments delegate staleOrigin/unreachable refusal to the library's probe and cap auto-recoveries via maxRecoveries: 1. The banner's recover() re-runs classification in the service.

expectations.text: Dirty-form protection uses trackUnsavedWork(() => form.dirty) in a component
expectations.evidence: editor-shell.component.ts — trackUnsavedWork(() => this.form.dirty) registered in the constructor, with markAsPristine() after save to unblock recovery.

expectations.text: Banner component reads SkewRecoveryService and uses its pending() signal and recover() method
expectations.evidence: update-banner.component.ts:28,37,72 — @if (recovery.pending()) template guard and (click)="recovery.recover()" on inject(SkewRecoveryService).
